name: Coaching Sahay for the Preparation of NEET, JEE, GUJCET Examination to both Socially and Educationally Backward Class Trainees/Students and Female Students and Economically Backward Class Students
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** - ₹20,000/- or actual coaching fee paid, whichever is lower. **Applicable Exams:** - NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) - JEE (Joint Entrance Examination) - GUJCET (Gujarat Common Entrance Test) **Mode of Disbursement:** - Amount is credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the student’s bank account.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be from the SEBC or Economically Backward Class category. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC/Class 10). 1. The applicant must be enrolled in or preparing for NEET, JEE, or GUJCET. 1. The applicant must have paid a coaching fee and be able to submit a valid receipt. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
